title: Disable RMF Sponge Crafting
description: Disables the ability to craft Sponges from Cheese in Reg's More Foods.
body:
## Overview
If, for whatever reason, you didn't want to be able to craft Sponges from Cheese in Reg's More Foods: well, here you go.

This datapack addon is perfect for server/realm admins who want to keep using Reg's More Foods, but don't want players to be able to craft Sponges easily (which is fine by me, hence why i've made this addon).

If you update Reg's More Foods, ensure you also download the correct version of *Disable RMF Sponge Crafting* for the version you're using to avoid errors and bugs!

### Extra Information
You can find the page for Reg's More Foods [here, on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/datapack/reg-more-foods) if you wish to give it a look. Don't forget that this datapack addon does nothing if you don't already have Reg's More Foods installed.

The modded version **requires** having Reg's More Foods in your modpack/mod list, so it may get upset at you if you don't have it yet. You can download it from the Modrinth link above.

There's currently a bug with how the datapack/mod works on Fabric. So until I can figure out what's causing it, the modded version is only available in Forge and Neoforge.
If you want it to work on Fabric, you can download the datapack version in the Versions tab.
